Anya (PM): Quick check — are we green on field readiness for the VPC/on-prem packaging sprint? Need go/no-go by EOD.
Raj (Platform Eng): Most CI jobs are passing. Remaining: installers for RHEL7 and airgap creds flow. Estimating ~2 dev-days to finish.
Sofia (Customer Success): We have 3 pilot customers lined up. They require static IP examples + an ops handoff doc. Also one customer asked for `netplan` examples.
Evan (Infra): Nightly smoke found networking init flakiness when kube-proxy is disabled. Suspect MTU mismatch across the overlay. Investigating.
Kim (Security): KMS integration needs an HSM rotation playbook and confirmation that audit logs capture netflow metadata and request IDs.
Anya (PM): OK — let's define explicit launch gates so we don't have surprise rollbacks. Proposed gates: 1) installer parity across supported OSes; 2) deterministic offline upgrade (checksums/manifests); 3) runbooks + field support training; 4) audit/logging + KMS sign-off.
Raj (Platform Eng): Adding a short technical gating checklist to be concrete:
```
- installer: deb/rpm/docker image parity + smoke install
- offline_upgrade: manifest + sha256 verification + rollback test
- network: iptables/nft fallback + MTU test vectors
- kms: key-sync test + rotation exercise
- telemetry: audit event schema includes netflow and request_id
```
Sofia (Customer Success): Can we add `support_oncall` training as a gate? Need a 2hr session and a one-page triage checklist for field engineers. I'll run the session.
Evan (Infra): Repro steps for the MTU flake I'm seeing:
1) disable kube-proxy on two nodes
2) run `iperf3 -c` between nodes with 1500/9000 MTU
3) observe retransmits and TCP stalls
I'll paste logs and packet captures to the Runbooks channel.
deploy-bot: [preview-build] build #542 succeeded — images pushed to registry `registry.redwood.internal/private-deploy/preview:542`.
Anya (PM): Proposed timeline: soft launch to pilots next Tuesday, GA in 3 weeks if no gating failures. Any objections?
Raj (Platform Eng): If we add one more airgapped upgrade test vector and get manifest validation PR merged today, I have confidence for the soft launch.
Kim (Security): I can sign off on soft launch contingent on audit schema bump merged and a short KMS rotation runbook.
Sofia (Customer Success): I'll schedule the training and send customer comms with a tentative install window. Also will prepare sample `netplan` and `ifcfg` configs.
Anya (PM): Action items (owners):
- Raj -> manifest validation PR + image parity checks
- Evan -> MTU mitigation + logs in Runbooks
- Kim -> audit schema PR + HSM rotation doc
- Sofia -> support training + customer comms + sample network configs
Ping this thread when complete. :thumbsup: 
Raj (Platform Eng): On it — will open the PR in 1hr.
Evan (Infra): Working on MTU patch, will post updates in 2h.
Kim (Security): Reviewing audit changes, plan to merge by EOD if no blockers.
Sofia (Customer Success): Training scheduled Thu 10:00am PST, invites sent.
Anya (PM): Thanks everyone. I'll make an EOD decision based on progress here. Marking this thread for the launch decision. :spiral_calendar:
